title: ZombieFlesh
description: Adds rotten flesh drops to Minecraft Beta 1.7.3
body:
# Zombie Flesh for Beta 1.7.3
 Adds rotten Flesh and feather drops from zombies

## Overview

Zombie Flesh Plugin for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 (tested on Bukkit-0.0.0-980-g4ed23b1-b1060jnks) 

Zombies now drop either a **Feather** or **Rotten Flesh**. Rotten Flesh can be eaten to restore health.


## Client-Side Texture pack required

Requires a client-side texture pack to display correctly.

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version:** Beta 1.7.3 only
- **Server Software:** Bukkit (tested on build 1060)

## Why dose this exist
In Beta 1.7.3, zombies originally dropped feathers (ID 288), used for crafting arrows. This plugin adds Rotten Flesh (ID 305).
